description.value: A community museum operated by the Qualicum Beach Historical and Museum Society since 1984, housing one of the finest paleontological collections in Western Canada alongside exhibits on Qualicum First Nation history, local social history, and natural history. The grounds feature notable outdoor exhibits including a totem pole by master Coast Salish carver Simon Charlie, and a restored Powerhouse heritage building with an energy history exhibit. Located on Beach Road in the heart of Qualicum Beach on Vancouver Island, it makes a worthwhile cultural stop for touring cyclists passing through the Oceanside region.
